Class Author

java.lang.Object
Author
public class Author extends Object
Entity class for Author.
Represents the author of a diary entry.

An Author object stores only a name, which may be changed after creation. This method for changing the name of the author is used for the JSON files, and will not be a part of the user interface. In addition to the name, the Author object has a diary entry count numberOfEntries which is set to zero when the author is created. Later this counter will be changed to count how many existing diary entries that specific author has written.

Responsibility:
This class holds information about an author, which is linked to the diary entries the author has written. It is used to identify who has written the different diary entries and to count how many existing entries the author has written. (If an entry is deleted, then the count will also * the author has written. (If an entry is deleted, then the count will also go down)

Information:
This class stores:
- name: The name of the author, stored as a String because names are textual.
- numberOfEntries: The count of diary entries written by the author, stored as an int because it is a simple numeric counter.
